name: magnetic-switch-slider
title: Magnetic Switch Slider
description: An industrial toggle lever sliding smoothly along a linear track with metallic snap detents and spring vibration.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Industrial
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Lever Bistable Throw: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
